```{r}
data <- read.csv("harmonized_Oct10_v2.csv") 
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(SiZer)
library(lter/HERON)
```

```{r}
#for log response ratio, we need the mean and sd/n of each treatment 
summary(data)

mean_sd <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Response.Variable)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Treatment)) %>%
  group_by(source, Date, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(means = mean(Response.Variable),
            response_sd = sd(Response.Variable),
            sample_size = n(),
            CV = sd(Response.Variable)/mean(Response.Variable))

head(mean_sd)

write.csv(mean_sd, "LR_master_file.csv")
```

```{r}
#For sizer analysis to find changes in linear trend sign in a time series
data_sub <- data %>%
  filter()
sizer_obj <- SiZer::SiZer(x = wrtds_core[[explanatory]], y = wrtds_core[[response]],
                          h = c(2, 10), degree = 1, derv = 1, grid.length = 100)

# Plot (and export) the SiZer object with horizontal lines of interest
png(filename = file.path("graphs", graph_outs, paste0(core_id, "_SiZer-plot.png")),
    width = 5, height = 5, res = 720, units = 'in')
HERON::sizer_plot(sizer_object = sizer_obj, bandwidth_vec = 5)
dev.off()

# Identify inflection points/slope changes
sizer_info <- HERON::sizer_slice(sizer_object = sizer_obj, bandwidth = 5)

# If there are changes and/or inflections, find inflections
inflects_raw <- c(sizer_info$neg_to_pos, sizer_info$pos_to_neg)
inflects <- inflects_raw[!is.na(inflects_raw)]

```
